T: Two men, one pair of skates, plenty of snacks.
D: Two rival figure skaters banned from singles competition team up as the first all-male pairs team.
P: Serve the snacks when Chazz says they will skate to Lady Hump.
S: Soft salted pretzels baked golden, with mustard and cheese sauce
Warm soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, with mustard and a cheese dip for the stands.
Garlic and chilli prawns grilled hot, piled on ice with lime
Chilli garlic prawns, hot off the grill, served on a bed of crushed ice with lime for the cold side.
M: Crumbed chicken with passata, ham and mozzarella, chips and salad
Crumbed chicken breast topped with tomato sauce, ham and melted cheese, with chips and salad, a proper competition dinner.
Chips, squeaky curds and hot gravy, the Montreal final way
Double-cooked chips under fresh cheese curds and a hot, peppery beef gravy, so the curds just start to melt.
W: Vanilla ice cream dipped in white chocolate and rolled in coconut
Coconut-coated vanilla ice cream balls rolled through white chocolate, frozen hard and served like little snowballs.
K: Thick hot chocolate with peppermint, whipped cream and candy cane

Thick hot chocolate made with dark chocolate and milk, a hint of peppermint, topped with whipped cream and crushed candy canes. Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp cocoa and 2 tbsp sugar until smooth and thick, about 4 minutes without boiling. Stir in half a tsp peppermint essence. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks. Pour the chocolate into 4 mugs, top with the cream and scatter with 2 crushed candy canes.

dishes.make_ahead: Shape the pretzels and keep them chilled on a tray up to 2 hours ahead; simmer in the bicarb water and bake on the night, best eaten warm

steps.text: Roll the pizza dough into ropes and twist into pretzels.
Dip each in the water simmering with the bicarb soda for 20 seconds, sprinkle with salt flakes and bake at 220C for 12 minutes.
Brush with the melted butter and serve with mustard and the cheese sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Toss the prawns with the oil, garlic and chilli up to 4 hours ahead and keep chilled; grill on the night and serve over ice

steps.text: Toss the peeled green prawns with the olive oil, the garlic cloves, the chopped red chilli and salt.
Grill on high for 2 minutes a side.
Pile over a platter of crushed ice and serve with lime wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Toss the haloumi with the oil, garlic and chilli up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; grill on the night and serve over ice

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into thick fingers and toss with the olive oil, the crushed garlic cloves and the chopped red chilli.
Grill on high for 2 to 3 minutes a side until charred.
Pile over a platter of crushed ice and serve straight away with lime wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Crumb the chicken up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled on a tray; top and bake on the night, with the chips going in at the same time

steps.text: Halve the large chicken breasts into thin fillets.
Crumb in flour, the eggs and the breadcrumbs and pan-fry until golden.
Top with the passata, the ham and the grated mozzarella and bake at 200C for 12 minutes.
Serve with chips and salad.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the eggplant up to 4 hours ahead and keep chilled on a tray; top and bake on the night, with the chips going in at the same time

steps.text: Slice the eggplants lengthways into 8 thick slices.
Crumb in the flour, the eggs and the breadcrumbs and pan-fry in the oil until golden.
Top with the passata, the smoked tofu and the grated mozzarella and bake at 200C for 15 minutes.
Bake the chips at 220C while the parmigiana cooks, then serve with salad.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the gravy up to 3 days ahead and reheat; bake the chips and build on the night

ingredients.item: cheese curds or torn fresh mozzarella

steps.text: Toss the chips in oil and salt and bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook until nutty brown.
Whisk in the stock and Worcestershire and simmer until glossy and thick. Pepper it well.
Pile the hot chips into bowls, scatter the curds and pour the hot gravy over.

steps.text: Toss the chips in oil and salt and bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook until nutty brown.
Whisk in the stock and soy and simmer until glossy and thick.
Pile the hot chips into bowls, scatter the curds and pour the hot gravy over.

dishes.make_ahead: Scoop, freeze, dip and roll the balls up to 1 week ahead and keep them in the freezer; nothing left to do on the night

steps.text: Scoop the vanilla ice cream into balls and freeze for 1 hour.
Melt the white chocolate with the coconut oil, dip each ball and roll straight away in the desiccated coconut.
Freeze until serving.

dishes.make_ahead: Whisk the chocolate base up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled and reheat gently; whip the cream and crush the candy canes on the night

Whisk in the chopped dark chocolate, the cocoa and the sugar until smooth and thick, about 4 minutes without boiling.
Stir in a little peppermint essence.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Pour the chocolate into mugs, top with the cream and scatter with the crushed candy canes.

s.note: Soft salted pretzels baked golden, with mustard and cheese sauce
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into 8 ropes and twist into pretzels. Dip each in 1L water simmering with 3 tbsp bicarb soda for 20 seconds, sprinkle with salt flakes and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brush with 30g melted butter and serve with mustard and 200g cheese sauce.

s.note: Garlic and chilli prawns grilled hot, piled on ice with lime
s.how: Toss 600g peeled green prawns with 3 tbsp olive oil, 3 garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli and salt. Grill on high for 2 minutes a side. Pile over a platter of crushed ice and serve with lime wedges.

m.note: Crumbed chicken with passata, ham and mozzarella, chips and salad
m.how: Halve 2 large chicken breasts into thin fillets. Crumb in flour, 2 eggs and 150g breadcrumbs and pan-fry until golden. Top with 200g passata, 4 slices ham and 150g grated mozzarella and bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Serve with chips and salad.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream dipped in white chocolate and rolled in coconut
w.how: Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 8 balls and freeze for 1 hour. Melt 200g white chocolate with 2 tbsp coconut oil, dip each ball and roll straight away in 100g desiccated coconut. Freeze until serving.

d.note: Thick hot chocolate with peppermint, whipped cream and candy cane
d.how: Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp cocoa and 2 tbsp sugar until smooth and thick, about 4 minutes without boiling. Stir in half a tsp peppermint essence. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks. Pour the chocolate into 4 mugs, top with the cream and scatter with 2 crushed candy canes.
